achievements.name: Epilogue: War is over
achievements.desc: The dogs of war have been raging insanely all around for so long. Too long for many. But I survived and I hope I am not the only one.

achievements.name: Diary: Day 7
achievements.desc: It's been seven days since we holed up here. Death is all around, but we've been lucky to keep everyone alive - so far...

achievements.name: Diary: Effing Snow
achievements.desc: Fucking snow. It buried half of the city so deep that we can't get there. No point waiting for the snow plows...

achievements.name: Diary: Finished ransacking
achievements.desc: We've explored every nook and cranny of our abode and there's nothing useful left to find. We must venture outside.

achievements.name: Note: Bless the radio
achievements.desc: The radio is useful beyond expectations. We get the news and it's so good to be reminded of normal life and the wide world.

achievements.name: Note: Distilled gold
achievements.desc: We finally managed to distill some moonshine. In a city under siege food and alcohol are always in high demand.

achievements.name: Note: Doubled the watch
achievements.desc: It's crucial to secure our place against night intruders. Two persons watching out for thieves can also watch out for each other.

achievements.name: Diary: Miraculous recovery
achievements.desc: This recovery from a grave illness proves that medicines work miracles. Or perhaps some of us have really robust immune systems.

achievements.name: Diary: Patched up and ready to go
achievements.desc: What good fortune, not only we managed to dress these critical wounds, but they are healing nicely. Someone must be praying for us.

achievements.name: Diary: Back from the brink
achievements.desc: With just kind words and deeds, we helped one of us survive the darkest depression that can kill just as dead as a bullet.

achievements.name: Diary: Hostel's open!
achievements.desc: We have now enough beds for everybody - that is, everybody but the one that has to go out and search for stuff.

achievements.name: Diary: Shooting for five stars
achievements.desc: For the first time since we wound up here all of us ate a hot meal. Let's not get accustomed yet.

achievements.name: Diary: First blood
achievements.desc: One of us survived our first brush with violent death. We hope against all odds there will be no more encounters like that.

achievements.name: Note: Creature comforts
achievements.desc: Our place is starting to resemble a proper home. Let's furnish it so we can live in a relative comfort, it keeps the spirits up.

achievements.name: Diary: Traces of lives
achievements.desc: Every building we visit has a story to tell. I'm wondering sometimes what kind of story we'll leave behind...

achievements.name: Diary: We Have Wintered
achievements.desc: The winter's gone. The freeze is over. We made it through... everyone made it! Amazing.

achievements.name: Epilogue: We made it!
achievements.desc: In the beginning, we didn't hope we'll all make it. So many died. And yet we're still here. This surely means something... right?

achievements.name: Diary: We've been everywhere
achievements.desc: We've combed through all the neighborhood, it's harder and harder to find anything useful. This war can't end soon enough.

achievements.name: Diary: We Made A Stand
achievements.desc: The bandits came in packs like dogs driven mad with hunger. We beat them back every night. And everyone survived. A miracle.

achievements.name: Note: A bit of indulgence
achievements.desc: For the first time we all indulged our addictions. It keeps the spirits up, and damn the health issues, we can die tonight anyway.

achievements.name: Note: Helping children
achievements.desc: It’s the children who suffer the most during war. They need all the help  they can get. Thank you!

achievements.name: Note: Street Art
achievements.desc: War can’t shut people’s mouths. Sometimes graffiti speaks more than a  thousand words.

achievements.name: Note: The school of life
achievements.desc: It’s crucial that kids learn to survive on their own. What if we don’t come back one night?

achievements.name: Diary: Our future
achievements.desc: We made it! Schools will reopen soon. From now on, kids will live a normal life again.

achievements.name: Note: Avoid the worst
achievements.desc: Attacking a place that shelters a kid… Atrocious! We stand together to protect our little one!

achievements.name: Note: Better days
achievements.desc: Kids… they sometimes seem to be far away from this war. It’s heartwarming.

achievements.name: Diary: Bond for life
achievements.desc: At least the kid has a new playmate. Maybe it will even be a break from our daily routine here.

achievements.name: Note: Everybody got to learn
achievements.desc: Solidarity. That’s the first thing we have to teach to our children.

achievements.name: Diary: Our own playground
achievements.desc: We wish we could be kids again and have fun with practically nothing.

achievements.name: Note: No more tears
achievements.desc: Nothing is more beautiful to see than a child smile and play again.

achievements.name: Epilogue: Exodus
achievements.desc: Safe at last, I looked back at the burning city and wept. I wished that all who wanted to leave it could do so. Escape from Pogoren.

achievements.name: Diary: The Truth
achievements.desc: Faced my demons and learned the truth of that horrible night.

achievements.name: Diary: Home Shelled Home
achievements.desc: Finally found a way back to the old apartment. Or whatever was left of it.

achievements.name: Diary: Compassion
achievements.desc: The hoodie meant the world to Amelia, but war turns everything upside down. This piece of cloth was crucial to this woman’s health. Maybe life.

achievements.name: Diary: The doctor
achievements.desc: The stakes were high, but I could not stay idle. I killed those soldiers, but I saved the doctor.

achievements.name: Note: Malik on duty
achievements.desc: Learn and broadcast all the news

achievements.name: Diary: You are a liar
achievements.desc: Lie to Malik on two or more occasions

achievements.name: Diary: Thruthful
achievements.desc: Tell Malik the truth at least twice

achievements.name: Epilogue: Heir
achievements.desc: Finish the game as Malik's successor

achievements.name: Epilogue: Remorse
achievements.desc: Finish the game apologising to Malik

achievements.name: Note: He is back home
achievements.desc: Let Adem return to the shelter

achievements.name: Note: Roll-up master
achievements.desc: Make one hundred cigarettes

achievements.name: Diary: Good Neighbor
achievements.desc: The winter was severe. I knew Tito used to help my father frequently. I decided to help him too.

achievements.name: Epilogue: All the way
achievements.desc: Complete the game with all the alternate endings.

achievements.name: Diary: The Janitor
achievements.desc: Zoran's destiny is fulfilled. We didn't burn any of our legacy.

achievements.name: Note: Fortify
achievements.desc: Our place was damaged in the bombing. We decided to reinforce all the pillars to buy us as much time as we can.

achievements.name: Note: Burn'em all
achievements.desc: Some people just want to watch the world burn.

achievements.name: Diary: Innocent children
achievements.desc: They had only their adoptive father - Adam. Now they have a glimmer of hope to survive this war.

achievements.name: Note: The truck is ready
achievements.desc: We finally managed to repair the truck. Now we can move our heritage to safety.

achievements.name: Note: The Colonel
achievements.desc: We gave the painting to Colonel Markov. Our heritage should be safe now.

achievements.name: Note: The Fence
achievements.desc: We gave the case files to Taras the fence. Our heritage should be safe now.

achievements.name: Diary: My dear Ruben
achievements.desc: We faced the harsh winter together and made it to the Museum, our new shelter.

achievements.name: Diary: The Custodian
achievements.desc: Milena's wish came true. We saved it all - our precious heritage.

achievements.name: Diary: Fool the Crow
achievements.desc: We acquired the truck parts without giving up Anja's necklace.

achievements.name: Epilogue: New life
achievements.desc: Livia managed to survive until the end of war and gave birth to her child in time of peace.

achievements.name: Forget Celebrations: Surviving Pogoren
achievements.desc: Despite the war raging on in Pogoren, Katia found a path to safety, leaving the chaos behind.

achievements.name: Forget Celebrations: Together We Escape
achievements.desc: Katia chose to wait for a second chance to flee the city – and when the moment came, she left with someone by her side.

achievements.name: Forget Celebrations: The Final Chapter
achievements.desc: With her precious book materials finally in hand, Katia waited for a second chance to escape the chaos of war.

achievements.name: Forget Celebrations: Speedwriting
achievements.desc: With her hard-earned book materials safely collected, Katia didn’t hesitate when the first chance to escape presented itself.
